caveat: This is pattern classification of one tissue section against known categories. It is not a validated per-patient prediction of treatment response.
conclusion: Immune-excluded tumour with spatially heterogeneous ERBB2 expression.
narrative: The section is classified as immune-excluded: tumour-immune neighbourhood enrichment z = -4.21 (p = 0.001, 1000 permutations); immune cells make up 8.3% of cells, of which 1.2% lie within tumour regions. ERBB2 is spatially heterogeneous among 8123 tumour cells (Moran's I = 0.412, p = 0.001). 688 of 25000 cells were removed at QC. The immune phenotype framework is described in REF-001; ERBB2 heterogeneity has been associated with lower pCR to HER2-targeted neoadjuvant therapy (REF-004).
